name: Lobster
description: Lobster workflow tool plugin for typed pipelines and resumable approvals.

directory.description: Lobster runtime state directory. Omit to use LOBSTER_STATE_DIR or the engine default. Workflow definitions stay in ordinary files.

backend.description: Storage backend. Omit to honor the selected store or LOBSTER_BACKEND, otherwise files. Changing an existing store requires explicit offline migration.

history.description: Record detailed execution history in addition to durable run status and saved review context.
